question: A random sample of 5 parts is taken from each of machines A and B. The measured length variances are 0.04 and 0.09 (mm²), respectively. Which machine is estimated to produce parts with more consistent lengths?
solution: Sample variance is used to estimate population consistency. A smaller variance indicates greater consistency. Since $0.04<0.09$, machine A is more consistent.
